method: The register was built from the 2025 National Seawater Utilization Report and official or authoritative government/utility disclosures, supplemented by Xinhua, People's Daily and sector reporting where the primary project page was not discoverable. A locality is included only when a source names the locality and documents a seawater-desalination project or a locality-specific plan; national or provincial totals are not converted into plant capacities. Where status, operator or capacity was not established at locality level, the field is explicitly UNKNOWN.
count_reconciliation: The register contains 12 independently sourced candidate localities and is short of the 167-project discovery universe; it is intentionally not padded. Project count and locality count are different quantities and neither may be substituted for the other. target_locality_node_count is UNKNOWN.

unresolved: The 2025 national report gives 167 projects and province totals but not a complete public locality-by-locality plant register; the missing 155 candidates require the underlying Ministry survey/project annex or provincial project inventories.

Qingdao locality reporting conflicts between 34.5万立方米/日 for three backbone projects and 30万立方米/日 for two application bases. Both are retained; a current utility asset register would close the discrepancy.
Tangshan 申港 total design capacity includes a demand-dependent third phase; a current operating permit or utility dispatch record is needed to separate operating from planned capacity.
Operator identities and capacities remain UNKNOWN for Sansha and Yancheng; commissioning certificates, utility disclosures or environmental acceptance documents would close them.
Province-level totals for Guangdong and Guangxi are not converted into locality nodes because no locality-specific project evidence was established in this pass.
count_semantics: 167 is the national 2025 count of desalination ENGINEERING PROJECTS. It is a discovery universe from which non-overlapping locality nodes are constructed. Some localities contain multiple desal projects, so the locality node count is not 167 and is not yet established. The previous field name `target_node_count` conflated the two and has been removed.

regional_parents.notes: 2025 disclosure states three large backbone projects in Qingdao (百发、百发扩建、董家口) have total capacity 34.5万立方米/日. This is a locality aggregate, not a single-plant capacity; it is retained as the Qingdao locality aggregate and should not be summed with Node-001. Disagreement: a 2025 Xinhua report describes two application bases at 30万立方米/日; both figures are recorded rather than silently reconciled.
regional_parents.geography_note: This entry aggregates Qingdao municipality, which geographically CONTAINS DJK-LATTICE-NODE-001 (Dongjiakou). It is therefore a REGIONAL PARENT, not a peer locality node. Its capacity is an aggregate and must never be summed with any of its child localities.
regional_parents.aggregation_rule: REGIONAL_PARENT totals are reporting-only. They may never be attributed back to a child node, and may never backfill a child node UNKNOWN.

ontology.peer_unit: LOCALITY_NODE — a non-overlapping geographic locality boundary
ontology.non_peer_unit: REGIONAL_PARENT — an aggregate that contains one or more localities
ontology.rule: A locality node may not geographically contain another locality node. Where a municipality contains its own localities, the municipality is a REGIONAL_PARENT and is not a peer of its children.
ontology.why: If geography is solved correctly at nodes 1-12, overlapping water, carbon, energy and waste ledgers do not have to be untangled at node 120.
ontology.next_step: Replace or subdivide the Qingdao regional parent with specific non-overlapping locality boundaries, for example a sourced Baifa service boundary, as each boundary is established.
